description: Stroke emergency — sudden facial drooping, slurred speech, and arm weakness. Should trigger a neurological red flag and route to Emergency.

mock_input.raw_transcript: My husband — something is wrong with him, please help. He was just sitting at the table and then suddenly his face just went all droopy on one side, he’s trying to talk but it’s not coming out right, like he’s slurring. And when I told him to raise both his arms he could only lift one. This just happened maybe five minutes ago.

ideal_output.priority_rationale: Classic FAST warning signs are present: facial drooping on one side, unilateral arm weakness, and slurred speech, all with sudden onset within 5 minutes. A background of atrial fibrillation significantly elevates the risk of acute cardioembolic events. This is a time-critical neurological emergency — immediate evaluation by emergency services is required without delay.
